turns.text: I don't blame you, those morning emails can be brutal. Hopefully, the caffeine did the trick! Is the Austin heat still pretty intense today?

turns.text: Oh, definitely. It is boiling outside. I'm keeping it super casual and light today, just wearing a fitted t-shirt and shorts to stay cool in the office.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good call, a fitted t-shirt is perfect for this Texas heat. Did you manage to step away from your desk to grab some lunch?

turns.text: I did! I actually brought a homemade salad today so I didn't have to venture out into the sun to find food.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move. A homemade salad sounds like the perfect refreshing lunch for a hot day. Did you put anything special in it to keep up with your vegetarian meals?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I tossed in some chickpeas, cucumbers, and a lemon tahini dressing. It was really good and kept things nice and light.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and very refreshing. Are you planning to do any climbing or guitar playing to unwind after work?

turns.text: I think I'll play some guitar this evening. Sam is out for the night, so I can practice some new chords without bothering anyone.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great way to relax. By the way, how are things going with your sister Ana's wedding planning? November will be here before we know it!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They're going well! She is finalizing the invitations this week, so things are getting busy. Anyway, I should probably get back to these logistics files, but I'll talk to you tomorrow!
